<mxfile host="Electron" pages="3" scale="1" border="10"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="IgfCk01zcrXkrIDxc_Im"> <mxGraphModel dx="1030" dy="626" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml ConceptualDomainModel_gadget_pos
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
hide methods
skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor #EEEDFE
 BorderColor #534AB7
}

class Role {
 Name
 Permission level
}

class \"Staff Member\" as StaffMember {
 Full name
 Login credentials
 Employment status
}

class Product {
 Name
 Category
 Selling price
 Quantity on hand
 Reorder threshold
}

class Sale {
 Receipt number
 Items sold
 Tax charged
 Total charged
 Payment state
}

class \"Sale Line Item\" as SaleLineItem {
 Product sold
 Quantity
 Price at time of sale
}

class Return {
 Original sale
 Amount refunded
 Reason
}

Role \"1\" -- \"many\" StaffMember : grants access to
StaffMember \"1\" -- \"many\" Sale : rings up
Sale \"1\" *-- \"many\" SaleLineItem : made up of
Product \"1\" -- \"many\" SaleLineItem : sold as
Sale \"1\" -- \"0..many\" Return : may be reversed by
StaffMember \"1\" -- \"many\" Return : approves

@enduml",
 "config": null

<mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml ERD_gadget_pos
!define TABLE(name) entity name << (T,#85B7EB) >>
hide circle
skinparam linetype ortho

TABLE(ROLES) {
 * id : INT <<PK>>
 --
 name : VARCHAR(60)
 access_level : ENUM('Admin','Manager','Cashier')
 created_at : TIMESTAMP
}

TABLE(USERS) {
 * id : INT <<PK>>
 --
 full_name : VARCHAR(120)
 username : VARCHAR(60)
 password_hash : VARCHAR(255)
 role : VARCHAR(60)
 status : ENUM('Active','Inactive')
 created_at : TIMESTAMP
}

TABLE(PRODUCTS) {
 * id : INT <<PK>>
 --
 sku : VARCHAR(30)
 name : VARCHAR(150)
 category : VARCHAR(80)
 price : DECIMAL(12,2)
 stock : INT
 reorder_level : INT
 active : TINYINT(1)
 created_at : TIMESTAMP
}

TABLE(TRANSACTIONS) {
 * id : INT <<PK>>
 --
 receipt_no : VARCHAR(40)
 cashier_name : VARCHAR(120)
 subtotal : DECIMAL(12,2)
 vat : DECIMAL(12,2)
 total : DECIMAL(12,2)
 status : ENUM('Paid','Returned')
 created_at : TIMESTAMP
}

TABLE(TRANSACTION_ITEMS) {
 * id : INT <<PK>>
 --
 # transaction_id : INT <<FK>>
 # product_id : INT <<FK>>
 product_name : VARCHAR(150)
 quantity : INT
 unit_price : DECIMAL(12,2)
 line_total : DECIMAL(12,2)
}

TABLE(RETURNS) {
 * id : INT <<PK>>
 --
 return_no : VARCHAR(40)
 receipt_no : VARCHAR(40)
 processed_by : VARCHAR(120)
 amount : DECIMAL(12,2)
 reason : VARCHAR(255)
 created_at : TIMESTAMP
}

' -- Enforced foreign keys (declared in schema.sql) --
TRANSACTIONS ||--o{ TRANSACTION_ITEMS : \"1 to many\n(FK, ON DELETE CASCADE)\"
PRODUCTS ||--o{ TRANSACTION_ITEMS : \"1 to many\n(FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT)\"

' -- Logical relationships (matched by value, not an enforced FK) --
ROLES ||..o{ USERS : \"assigned to\n(users.role = roles.name)\"
TRANSACTIONS ||..o{ RETURNS : \"refunded via\n(returns.receipt_no = transactions.receipt_no)\"

note bottom of USERS
 role is stored as free text,
 not a real foreign key to ROLES
end note

note bottom of RETURNS
 receipt_no is stored as free text,
 not a real foreign key to TRANSACTIONS
end note

@enduml",
 "config": null

 "data": "@startuml DesignClassDiagram_gadget_pos
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor #E1F5EE
 BorderColor #0F6E56
}

class Role {
 -int id
 -String name
 -String accessLevel
 --
 +getPermissions() : List
}

class User {
 -int id
 -String fullName
 -String username
 -String passwordHash
 -String role
 -String status
 --
 +authenticate(pwd : String) : boolean
 +hasAccess(action : String) : boolean
 +deactivate() : void
}

class Product {
 -int id
 -String sku
 -String name
 -String category
 -decimal price
 -int stock
 -int reorderLevel
 -boolean active
 --
 +isLowStock() : boolean
 +adjustStock(qty : int) : void
}

class Transaction {
 -int id
 -String receiptNo
 -String cashierName
 -decimal subtotal
 -decimal vat
 -decimal total
 -String status
 --
 +addItem(product : Product, qty : int) : void
 +calculateTotal() : decimal
 +markReturned() : void
}

class TransactionItem {
 -int id
 -int transactionId
 -int productId
 -String productName
 -int quantity
 -decimal unitPrice
 -decimal lineTotal
 --
 +calculateLineTotal() : decimal
}

class Return {
 -int id
 -String returnNo
 -String receiptNo
 -String processedBy
 -decimal amount
 -String reason
 --
 +process() : void
}

Role \"1\" o-- \"many\" User : role
User \"1\" --> \"many\" Transaction : processes
Transaction \"1\" *-- \"many\" TransactionItem : items
Product \"1\" --> \"many\" TransactionItem : referencedBy
User \"1\" --> \"many\" Return : processedBy
Transaction \"1\" --> \"0..many\" Return : refundedBy

@enduml",
